plugins.changelogTitle:
# Changelog

Every release is generated from the commit history; see CONTRIBUTING.md for the conventions that drive it.

plugins.prepareCmd: test "$PACKED_VERSION" = '${nextRelease.version}' || { echo "::error::semantic-release computed ${nextRelease.version}, but the pack job packed '$PACKED_VERSION'." >&2; exit 1; }

plugins.releaseBodyTemplate:
<%= nextRelease.notes %>
<% const packageIds = (env.RELEASE_PACKAGE_IDS || "").split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean); if (packageIds.length) { %>
### NuGet packages

| Package | Version |
| --- | --- |
<% packageIds.forEach(function (id) { %>| `<%= id %>` | [<%= nextRelease.version %>](https://www.nuget.org/packages/<%= id %>/<%= nextRelease.version %>) |
<% }); %>
The `.nupkg` and `.snupkg` files attached to this release, and every assembly inside them, carry a signed build provenance attestation (`AdCodicem.Pdf.<%= nextRelease.version %>.sigstore.json`). nuget.org re-signs each `.nupkg`, which changes its digest, but leaves the assemblies as they were packed, so a package restored from nuget.org is checked through one of them:

```sh
gh attestation verify ~/.nuget/packages/adcodicem.pdf/<%= nextRelease.version %>/lib/net10.0/AdCodicem.Pdf.dll --repo AdCodicem/AdCodicem.Pdf --signer-workflow AdCodicem/AdCodicem.Pdf/.github/workflows/release.yml
```
<% } %>
